fact: In 2024 mobile money carried 64.6% of remittances received from the Senegalese diaspora (CFAF 1,939.6 billion, against 45.8% in 2023), including CFAF 206.2 billion from the UEMOA zone.
title: Balance des paiements et position extérieure globale au titre de l'année 2024
